title: The outage audit is done: two mechanism gaps, not two rule gaps.

text: A Server/ save that parsed but could not boot, and a supervisor that could not restart a child that had already died. The fix that makes this impossible is one task - the supervisor boot-tests a candidate on a spare port before swapping, and keeps the healthy server running if it fails. Report: /framework/ai/2026-09-19/incident-site-down/
